title: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who were not admitted to the hospi
question: Among female patients diagnosed with SLE who were not admitted to the hospital, what percentage have both abnormal total protein levels (outside 6.0–8.5) and elevated LDH (>500)?

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN (L."XCL_020" < 6.0 OR L."XCL_020" > 8.5) AND L."XCL_018" > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND E."XCL_013" = 0
